description: Evaluation labels for the Aquashield vision triage model
note: Preliminary labels drafted from visual review of the supplied 30-page PDF in page order. Water-depth tiers are visual estimates, not measured ground truth. Image provenance/credits were not supplied and are intentionally omitted.

labels.notes: Deep-looking water; depth is visual estimate.

labels.notes: Vehicles appear to be negotiating or stopped in floodwater; stranded status needs review.

labels.notes: Water depth varies and is difficult to estimate.

labels.notes: Normal busy street scene.

labels.description: Urban road with standing water around a damaged or excavated section, loose rubble, and a Delhi Police barricade; a person is partially submerged in the water.
labels.notes: A worker appears to be clearing a roadside drain or excavation. Rubble and standing water are visible. The drain blockage is inferred from the cleaning activity.

labels.description: Close-up of a concrete drain or manhole containing stagnant muddy water and a dark curved object, possibly a pipe or debris.
labels.notes: Drain blockage is suspected from the stagnant water and object inside the opening, but the obstruction is not conclusively identifiable. No road surface is visible. Review the blockedDrain label against the dataset's ground-truth criteria.

schema.isRoadScene: boolean — true if image shows a recognizable road/street
schema.floodedRoad: boolean — true if standing water visibly covers the road
schema.difficulty: easy|medium|hard (subjective assessment of how hard the image is to classify)

instructions: 1. Place images in data/eval/images/ using filenames eval_01.png through eval_32.png.
2. Keep one entry per image in the labels array.
3. Run evaluation only after validating image files, labels, and inference mode.
4. Never report mock evaluation metrics as real model performance.
